direction_as_read: mixed: IBS meta-analysis positive but the largest trial is not superior to control and the pilot missed its primary endpoint; glycaemic meta-analyses favour aloe with authors flagging poor quality, heterogeneity and unstandardized preparations
summary: The labels print aloe extract, aerial part or leaf extract, gel, powder or concentrate at up to 470 mg, some with digestive and metabolic purposes. For IBS, a three-trial meta-analysis favours aloe (30153721), yet a pilot missed its primary endpoint (26405698), the largest trial was not superior to inulin (32314514), and the only clear subgroup result is post hoc (34646359). For glycaemia, meta-analyses favour aloe (27009750, 27347994), and their authors cite high heterogeneity, poor quality and a need for standardized preparations. No abstract read links a result to a preparation these labels print at a stated amount.
